descriptionChirho: Qal sense: to be wise, become wise, or act wisely, used of persons gaining or possessing wisdom (includes imperative 'be wise!' and all Qal inflections).
Piel and Hifil causative sense: to make someone wise, to impart wisdom or understanding to another (e.g., God's commands making the simple wise).
Pual passive sense: to be made wise or skillful, describing one who has been endowed with wisdom or expert skill (e.g., a skilled craftsman).
Hitpael reflexive sense: to show oneself wise or to make oneself wise, used as a warning against self-aggrandizing pursuit of wisdom.
Hitpael cohortative sense: to deal wisely or shrewdly with someone, implying cunning strategy or scheming (as in Exodus 1:10, Pharaoh's plan against Israel).
